property_summary: For any caller address that is a Bank-like contract returning keccak256("Nu Token") from supportsToken(), calling airDrop from that caller when its tokenBalance was 0 will result in tokenBalance(caller) == 20 on the correct contract; the mutant that compares against "Other Token" will reject such Bank callers and thus for some caller-contract address the post-call tokenBalance remains 0 (violating the rule).
change_summary: Make supportsToken always fail by comparing to a different string, preventing airDrop from succeeding for callers relying on Bank.supportsToken.
